scripts.check:quality: calcit analyze weak-types --format json | jq -es -f config/calcit-quality.jq && calcit analyze weak-types --only coverage --summary-only --format json | jq -es 'length == 1 and .[0].data.summary.levels == {full: .[0].data.summary.definitions, none: 0, partial: 0}' && calcit analyze weak-types --only deprecated-call --summary-only --format json | jq -es 'length == 1 and .[0].data.summary.calls == 0'
scripts.audit:unsafe: calcit calcit.cirru analyze weak-types --only unsafe-coerce --intent explicit-unsafe --format json

scripts.test:browser: yarn compile:browser && node browser-node-contract.mjs && node --test tests/webgpu-calcit-capabilities.node.mjs && node tests/run-browser.mjs
